description:
You are an energy engineer retrofitting a commercial office building. The owner wants to install Dual-Fuel Heat Pumps on the Ground Floor to reduce carbon emissions while maintaining gas backup for cold days.

Your task is to update the HVAC systems in the `4StoreyBuilding` model:
1. Locate all five Ground Floor (G.*) Packaged Single-Zone (PSZ) systems in the Air-Side HVAC module.
2. Configure them as Dual-Fuel Heat Pumps:
   - Set the Heat Source (`HEAT-SOURCE`) to `Heat Pump`.
   - Set the Supplemental Heat Source (`SUPPL-HEAT-SOURCE`) to `Furnace` (this provides the gas backup).
   - Set the Minimum Heat Pump Temperature (`MIN-HP-T`) to `35`°F (the switchover temperature).
3. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to validate the system performance.
4. Save the project.

No step-by-step navigation instructions are provided. You must find the specific systems and parameters in the eQUEST interface.
